text: Found myself in Chiang Mai and in terrible pain from weeks of travel and eating.  I knew I needed help and sought out a colonic.  Much to my relief I found this little clinic run by two lovely ladies that took tender care of me.  Although I struggled with the language barrier a bit, we all got along well, and despite how awkward an experience it can be, they were gentle and professional.  Its not as modern as the systems in Bangkok but it still did the job. It was a closed system so there wasn't any unpleasant odor.  There was a viewing tube but from my position I couldn't really see it.  I felt it though, and they would advise me when we had a successful release.  I made sure to photograph their entire book of services to encourage others that might be wondering what all they offer.  Please check them out if you require any Ayurvedic medicinal care.  They will care for you with warmth and compassion.

This place is run by two women who work together as a fantastic team! their coordination is amazing! Booking an appointment is super easy, and they are incredibly kind and professional.

Given how uncomfortable the colonic process can be, they really make you feel at home and completely at ease. It’s such a pleasure to meet people like them in the world. I couldn’t recommend this place more!

Nice simple Ayurvedic center, friendy staff that make the colon irrigation a comfortable experience ( well as comfortable as it can be) Kambuch and waternserved afterwards. Will be back to for the detox min package before I leave Thai. Even my mate gave it a who chickened  out years ago the first time I tried this but in south Thai....

Very affordable colonic treatment by very gentle staff. My first time coming here was 6 years ago when I had a bad stomach flu and this treatment helped so much. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a cleanse.

First time doing a colonic. Lovely ladies made it as comfortable as possible + both did an excellent job. I really enjoyed the woman massaging my stomach helping to get everything out. They give you some kombucha after as well. You can see everything coming out, which was quite cool but you can also look away if you don’t want to see that 😅

Highly recommend! Very gentle, very affective. Slight discomfort with the movement in the tummy but omg I feel sooo much better. Thank you to the two ladies who handles me with care. No pain at all. I will be coming back for regular maintenance

Absolute love. After suffering for years with terrible constipation I gave up on the doctors and their fiber supplements. Once I was reduced to having a movement once a week at best it was time to think outside the box.  I shunned my fears and shyness and came to The Ayervedic center. I set the appointment by email and arrived the next day. The two lovely ladies on staff at the time took great care to preserve my dignity throughout the process. They truly went above and beyond during both visits to ensure all the old impacted matter was cleaned out of me. I should have had three but called back to Bangkok for business and then back home to the states. I  have had zero issues since the treatment and now am able to have normal movements on a daily basis. I feel like a new man, I am losing weight and the aches and pains are gone. When I go back to Chiang Mai I will be visiting again even if only to thank the staff.
Very nice ladies who made me feel very comfortable during my treatment there. During the colon hydrotherapy sessions I had one lady is massaging your stomach. Really recommend.

I had colonic irrigation in the clinic and could not recommend it enough. The nurses were extremely polite and helpful. During the first session, which was the most painful, they made everything for me to feel comfortable. During each session, one nurse massaged my abdomen with warm oil: Heaven! I would come back to Chiang Mai just to repeat the treatment!

The lady’s were very helpful and calming. I did not feel uncomfortable at all with this experience. I felt very light and relaxed after session it made me more aware of what to put in my body afterwards. I will definitely recommend them and will visit again.
they know what they are doing! an amazing value.  $34 for two skilled and kind helpers and a very healing therapy. very calm atmosphere. the intestinal massage takes it to another level!
